_comment: Version matrix for the lifecycle qualification harness (distributed-testing F1/F4).
F4 consumes the `standalone` section of each pair; F2 extends this file with a
`cluster` section per pair and may add further adjacent pairs. Never reference the
`latest` tag: it was last pushed in 2021, is amd64-only, and is not a release.
Supported old->new is the single adjacent pair v0.1.0 -> candidate (F1 Q4 decision).
Skip-version upgrades are unsupported until a test exercises them.

previous.cli_smoke: scripts/ci-cli-smoke.sh <binary> <arch> (existing amd64/arm64 checksum + bare-host smoke gate; not re-run here)

_comment: There is no product version surface yet (F1 prerequisite 3: the binary reports no
build SHA), so candidate_sha is bound to the image EXTERNALLY. Preferred: do NOT
pre-build — let scripts/lifecycle-tests.sh run the `build` command above itself,
from a clean checkout whose HEAD equals the tag; it records provenance
`built-by-this-run` with the resulting image id. A supplied or already-present
image is recorded `supplied/unverified` and BLOCKS the qualification unless
CAESIUM_LIFECYCLE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_IMAGE=1 is set, which is itself recorded in
provenance.verified_when: the harness built the image from a clean checkout at candidate_sha

feature_discriminator._comment: Present on the candidate, absent on v0.1.0. A behavioural cross-check of image identity only; the authoritative check is the container's image ID.

_comment: The shard count is frozen for the life of a data directory (F1): a run's rows
live in fnv32a(run_id) % len(hot) and raising CAESIUM_DATABASE_SHARDS does not
rebalance existing hot rows. Both sides of a supported transition must use the
value below; a changed count is an unsupported transition, exercised only as a
recorded-outcome case on a COPY of the volume.
_column_additions_comment: skip_reason is a field of models.JobRun and data_violations a field of
models.TaskRun: there is no job_runs.data_violations column and never will be.
Each pinned addition is asserted on exactly the table named here.
This list is a REQUIRED MINIMUM, not an exhaustive delta: additions observed
beyond it are recorded in the qualification record rather than failed, because
an `exactly these' check would turn red on the next model addition while this
runner is not yet in CI (G6 wires it in).
AutoMigrate is additive and name-blind: it never drops a column and matches an
index by NAME only. The assertion that nothing from the v0.1.0 snapshot
disappeared is measured live, not pinned.
standalone._index_repair_comment: TaskRun's composite index tag is byte-identical at v0.1.0 and at the candidate, so this pair does NOT exercise MigrateTaskRunUniquePartitionIndex. The first qualified upgrade is a purely additive case.

transitions.description: previous release stopped with `docker stop -t 60`, candidate started on the same named volume

candidate restarted on the retained volume with a different CAESIUM_NODE_ADDRESS; it reconciles info.yaml and the discovery cache, recovers the sole member's raft configuration after checking for reachable peers, and goes ready
transitions.expect: starts; info.yaml records the new address; every pre-upgrade identity still readable

transitions.description: the pinned v0.1.0 image started on its own copy of the volume with a different CAESIUM_NODE_ADDRESS
transitions.expect: exit status 1, the `address ... in info.yaml does not match` fatal from pkg/db/db.go, and no healthy /health
transitions._comment: v0.1.0 has no address reconciliation, so this is why `upgrade first, re-address second' is the only supported order.

transitions.description: v0.1.0 restarted on a COPY of the candidate-migrated volume
transitions._comment: F1 records restore-from-snapshot as the intended recovery and binary rollback as NOT supported. The observed outcome is recorded; a passing attempt does not create a guarantee.

transitions.description: candidate restarted on a COPY of the volume with CAESIUM_DATABASE_SHARDS changed
transitions._comment: A silently successful start that strands existing hot rows is a finding to file, not a pass.
